topic: That ticking at idle might just be your injectors - or it might not

beats.narration: That ticking under the hood at idle - is it normal, or a problem?
beats.visualPrompt: Static wide shot of a car idling in a driveway or shop bay, engine bay slightly visible through a cracked hood, still morning light.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: A light, steady tick from the engine bay, mostly noticeable when the car's just sitting there.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up static shot on an idling engine bay, subtle rhythmic vibration cue, shallow depth of field on the injector rail area.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One clue: that's often just a fuel injector opening and closing - completely normal.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a fuel injector removed and resting on a clean shop rag, pintle tip visible, slow push-in, bright even lighting.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: But a louder tick, a rough idle, or a check-engine light together can mean something more - like low fuel pressure.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a dashboard check-engine light illuminated, static mount, paired cut to a fuel-pressure gauge needle held on a test rig.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't guess which one it is. A quick listen and a pressure check can tell the difference.
beats.visualPrompt: Underhood inspection shot: a mechanic's stethoscope-style listening tool positioned near the injector rail, tool mounted/clipped, no hand in frame.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking if it's paired with anything else. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo/CTA text composited in post, not AI-generated.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

feedCaption: Hear a ticking under the hood at idle? Often that's just a fuel injector doing its job. But paired with a rough idle or a check-engine light, it's worth a second look. Don't guess - stop by and we'll take a look.
